integrity: Algebraic proof independently reconstructed; exact symbolic verification and rational stationary-chain comparisons supplied; finite computations are supportive, not proof of the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Stationary exchangeable binary-patch Markov model only; uniqueness of the correlation maximum proved for three patches, existence but not uniqueness for larger populations. No field calibration or estimation theory. Full text for some relevant early SIS covariance studies was unavailable, leaving historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp onset of nonmonotone spatial occupancy correlation in finite mainland–island metapopulations
